precepts.text: All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever. The Most High deals with bribes.
precepts.point: For it is not a light thing to do wickedly against the laws of God. Sometimes we take the laws of the Most High for granted with the mentality, I can sin and God won't do nothing.
precepts.why:
Jason bought the high priesthood with bribes, and three years later he got a taste of it himself: Menelaus, Simon’s brother, offered the king three hundred talents of silver more than Jason and “got the priesthood to himself.” Jason, who had undermined his own brother, was undermined by another and had to flee into the country of the Ammonites.

Sirach says: “All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever.” The Most High deals with bribes. Here comes Jason, the brother of Onias the high priest, trying to bribe his way in, and it is blotted out.

Sometimes it is not good enough for a brother to be the support brother. Onias was high priest and his brother should have supported him, but Jason said, I can do a better job, plus have access to all that money. Look at a man’s motives. Bribery does not last; true dealing endures for ever.

points: All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out. Every last injustice that was done to us, the Lord is going to deal with them concerning it.

You saw what happened the other day with the Epstein files: western leaders named, unspeakable crimes against children, victims crying to the court system to release the files, and no judgment. This is an unjust system. But even though there is no justice from this unjust system, the most high God is going to bring justice on them.

points: Great travail is created for every man, and an heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day they go out of their mother's womb till the day that they return to the mother of all things: from birth to death. Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, trouble their thoughts and cause fear of heart.

Trauma causes long term changes to key brain regions: the amygdala (threat detection), the hippocampus (memory and context; that is why sometimes you cannot remember things), and the prefrontal cortex (decision making and regulation; some people keep making horrible decisions and do not understand why). Dysregulation symptoms: hyperarousal, constantly on edge, irritable, anxious, panicky; or hypoarousal, feeling numb, exhausted, disconnected, emotionally detached. Brother, why are you missing assignments, why are you not on the Telegram, what is going on in your life? The first thing we say is, he is out of the spirit; that may be true, but why is what we should be asking.

points: From him that sitteth on a throne of glory, unto him that is humbled in earth and ashes: it does not matter if you are rich or poor; every man and woman has the same issues. Money does not heal trauma; that is why many athletes and entertainers fall apart when they retire and have to actually be with themselves.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: And in the time of rest upon his bed his night's sleep do change his knowledge: you overthink at night. Some of you wake up out of evil dreams, dreams of death, of losing a loved one, of losing your job, and you are troubled in the vision of your heart as if you escaped out of a battle; and when all is safe, you awake and marvel that the fear was nothing. Thank God it was just a dream. Every man and woman goes through this, because when Adam fell, we all fell.

Some of us have that rest and digest side jacked up: our bodies are not able to get into a state of calm, we barely sleep, and our bodies are not healing. The Bible is telling you all flesh goes through these things, but it is worse in sin.

note.label: Shapen in Iniquity: Resetting the Nervous System

points: Teaching on the nervous system: the central nervous system is the command center, the brain and spinal cord; the peripheral nervous system is the communication network carrying signals between the brain and your organs, muscles, and skin. You put your hand on a hot stove, and the signal makes you feel the pain and pull away; the nervous system is built to protect you. The somatic system controls voluntary movement; the autonomic system regulates involuntary functions like heart rate, digestion, and breathing; the sympathetic side is fight or flight, activating the body for survival; the parasympathetic side is rest and digest, calming the body, conserving energy, and promoting healing.

points: Such things happen unto all flesh, both man and beast, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners. It is seven times worse if you are in sin. Hold that verse; we are coming back to it.

points: Wine and musick rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both. When you drink some wine your heart is merry; on the feast days we play music and everybody dances and has fun. But above them both is wisdom.

So the joy of the Lord is not just having fun on the feast days. That same joy you have for wine and music, you are supposed to have in learning wisdom. That's why every feast day and every new moon we go over the scriptures; this is supposed to be the better part. You're not supposed to be sitting there asking why the class is two hours. You are supposed to be excited, because you're learning things that haven't been taught for over 2,000 years or were forgotten. If you don't have joy in learning the wisdom of God, you have to pray and ask God for it. You should be around the brothers, and a brother pulls a scripture, and you say, let me write that down and put that in my notes.

points: Go to the last scripture. It says restore the joy.

Because oftentimes those brothers and sisters that fall to an evil heart of unbelief, they do not read. They do show up to the school. Yes, you will see a Bible in their hand. Yes, you will see them on security. Yes, you will see them in the kitchen. Yes, they will be in broadcast. Yes, they will be on the board. Yes, they will do some good works. Maybe they set up a garden. Maybe they bring in the best unleavened bread.

But the other six days and eighteen hours, or fifteen hours, or whatever, that they are not in the midst of the body — that is what they have to examine. That is what you have to examine within yourself.
Wine and music rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both. You must love wisdom in order to restore and reset your joy of salvation. You must.

It is not a matter of, well, maybe if I do something else, maybe if I go out to enough outings or whatever. Okay, that is cool. But if you do not love the scriptures, and if you are not searching the scriptures to fix you, you are going to fall to an evil heart of unbelief.
